file: 263 Dont Splash on Roblox Or the Monster Hears You.mp4

lines.t: This new fun game on Roblox is a horror game where you must not make a splash. Because it hears you.

full.credit: Clips: BemmyBlock; SSundee; UnoTwo (Roblox gameplay, YouTube)

sc.big:
THIS NEW FUN
GAME ON ROBLOX

lines.t: You cross flooded rooms, called the Poolrooms, without touching the water. One splash, and the blind monster comes for you.

full.credit: Clips: BemmyBlock; SSundee; UnoTwo (Roblox gameplay, YouTube)

lines.t: It launched with four rooms. Now there are nine, and the harder modes bring more monsters.

full.credit: Clips: BemmyBlock; SSundee; UnoTwo (Roblox gameplay, YouTube)

lines.t: It came out on October 17th, and it already has over 180 million visits.

full.credit: Clips: BemmyBlock; SSundee; UnoTwo (Roblox gameplay, YouTube)

lines.t: Could you cross the Poolrooms without a splash?

full.credit: Clips: BemmyBlock; SSundee; UnoTwo (Roblox gameplay, YouTube)
